T: The moon landing, live from a sheep paddock.
D: A radio telescope in a sheep paddock in Parkes helps broadcast the 1969 moon landing.
P: Serve the snacks when the first pictures come through from the moon.
S: the town ladies' welcome for the Americans

Self-raising flour with cold butter rubbed in, milk and a little cream mixed in lightly with a knife, patted out, cut into rounds, packed close on the tray, baked at 220C for 12 minutes. Jam and whipped cream.
the whole town watching the moon landing

Light butter sponge cubes dipped in glossy chocolate icing and rolled in coconut, some split and filled with raspberry jam and whipped cream. Bake a 20 x 30cm butter sponge (125g butter, 150g caster sugar, 2 eggs, 225g self-raising flour, 125ml milk) at 180C for 25 minutes, cool and chill. Cut into 16 squares. Mix 400g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 20g butter and 125ml boiling water. Dip each square, roll in 200g desiccated coconut and set. Split half and fill with jam and whipped cream.
the boys play cricket on the dish
Cheese and yeast spread scrolls: yeast spread and tasty cheese rolled in scone dough, sliced, baked at 200C for 15 minutes.
M: the town's big night for the US ambassador
Lamb rack roasted at 200C to 56C, rested, carved into cutlets, with roast potatoes, pumpkin, peas and mint sauce.

Minute steak, caramelised onions, beetroot, cheese, lettuce, tomato and a fried egg on toasted Turkish bread, with chips and aioli. Cook 2 sliced onions in butter for 20 minutes until jammy. Bake 750g frozen chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Season 4 minute steaks and sear 1 minute a side in a smoking pan, adding a slice of tasty cheese to each. Fry 4 eggs. Toast 4 halved Turkish rolls. Build with mayonnaise, lettuce, tomato, 8 slices beetroot, steak, onions and egg. Serve with chips and garlic aioli.
W: a big white moon, the one everyone's watching
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar until glossy, cornflour and vinegar folded in, shaped into a perfect round, baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven. Cream and passionfruit on top.
K: a hot day out in the sheep paddock under the dish

Ice-cold lager topped with homemade fizzy lemon and lime soda, poured into chilled pot glasses with a lemon wedge. Mix the juice of 2 lemons and 2 limes with 80ml sugar syrup. Chill 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour 25ml of the citrus syrup into each glass, add 125ml cold soda water, then top slowly with 175ml cold Australian lager. Stir once and add a lemon wedge. Make extra with just soda for the drivers.

s.note: the town ladies' welcome for the Americans
s.how: Rub 60g cold butter into 350g self-raising flour. Mix in 200ml milk and 50ml cream lightly with a knife. Pat out, cut rounds and pack close on a tray. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with strawberry jam and 250ml whipped cream.

s.note: the boys play cricket on the dish
s.how: Rub 60g butter into 300g self-raising flour and mix in 200ml milk to a soft dough. Roll into a rectangle, spread thinly with yeast spread and cover with 150g grated tasty cheese. Roll up, slice into 12 and bake at 200C for 15 minutes.

m.note: the town's big night for the US ambassador
m.how: Roast 800g potatoes and 600g pumpkin at 200C for 45 minutes. Roast 2 lamb racks at 200C until 56C inside, rest and carve into cutlets. Cook 300g peas. Mix chopped mint with 3 tbsp vinegar, a spoon of sugar and hot water for mint sauce.

w.note: a big white moon, the one everyone's watching
w.how: Whip 4 whites to soft peaks, add 220g caster sugar gradually until glossy, then fold in 1 tsp cornflour and 1 tsp vinegar. Shape a perfect round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with 300ml whipped cream and 4 passionfruit.

d.note: a hot day out in the sheep paddock under the dish
d.how: Mix the juice of 2 lemons and 2 limes with 80ml sugar syrup. Chill 4 pot glasses in the freezer for 15 minutes. Pour 25ml of the citrus syrup into each glass, add 125ml cold soda water, then top slowly with 175ml cold Australian lager. Stir once and add a lemon wedge. Make extra with just soda for the drivers.
